title: The two loops' shared-checkout guard is one-directional and blocks on a stale pid file
body: playtest-loop.sh refuses to start when ai-runs/loop.pid exists (a bare -f test), while loop.sh authenticates its own record by pid and start tick. A stale loop.pid therefore blocks the playtest loop forever, and the playtest loop writes no record of its own, so starting the dev loop second in the same checkout is unguarded; the dev loop's red-gate git reset --hard then changes the build under a player mid-run. Share the process-record helpers (write and authenticate) between both drivers, have playtest-loop.sh write ai-runs/playtest-loop.pid, and have loop.sh refuse when an authenticated playtest record is alive. From docs/REPO_AUDIT_2026-09.md finding 4/10, confirmed 2026-09-05.
